title: Nano Banana 2 Edit
description: Nano Banana 2 is Google's new state-of-the-art image generation and editing model

pricing.text: Your request will cost $0.08 per image. For $1.00, you can run this model 12 times. 2K and 4K outputs will be charged at 1.5 times and 2 times the standard rate, respectively. 0.5K (512px) resolution outputs will be charged at 0.75 times the standard rate. If web search is used, an additional $0.015 will be charged. If high thinking is used, an additional $0.002 will be charged. Note: Pricing is subject to change.

inputs.name: num_images
inputs.tooltip: The number of images to generate.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The seed for the random number generator. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.tooltip: The aspect ratio of the generated image. Supports extreme ratios: 4:1, 1:4, 8:1, 1:8.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: The safety tolerance level for content moderation. 1 is the most strict (blocks most content), 6 is the least strict.

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: The URLs of the images to use for image-to-image generation or image editing. Optional when at least one of `video_url`, `audio_url`, or `pdf_url` is provided. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is number 1).

inputs.name: system_prompt
inputs.tooltip: Optional system instruction that steers the model's persona and output style across the request. Leave blank to omit; when provided, it is sent as the system instruction to Gemini (or as a system message on OpenAI-compatible providers). Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.tooltip: The resolution of the image to generate.

inputs.name: video
inputs.tooltip: Optional video to use as input context. Accepts an http(s)/data URL to a video file (downloaded and sent inline, max 15MB) or a YouTube URL (passed through to the model without downloading).

inputs.name: audio
inputs.tooltip: Optional audio file to use as input context. Accepts an http(s)/data URL (downloaded and sent inline, max 15MB).

inputs.name: pdf_url
inputs.tooltip: Optional PDF document to use as input context. Accepts an http(s)/data URL (downloaded and sent inline, max 15MB). Paste a link; leave empty to leave it out.

inputs.name: limit_generations
inputs.tooltip: Experimental parameter to limit the number of generations from each round of prompting to 1. Set to `True` to to disregard any instructions in the prompt regarding the number of images to generate and ignore any intermediate images generated by the model. This may affect generation quality.

inputs.name: enable_web_search
inputs.tooltip: Enable web search for the image generation task. This will allow the model to use the latest information from the web to generate the image.

inputs.name: thinking_level
inputs.tooltip: When set, enables model thinking with the given level ('minimal' or 'high') and includes thoughts in the generation. Omit to disable. '(not set)' leaves it to the model.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
